purpose: Instructions only; not an attestation or passing review. Supply actual fresh execution provenance.
canonical_json: sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8, no trailing newline

dispatch.timestamp: actual dispatch timestamp, at or after candidate.created_at
dispatch.record_digest: SHA256 of retained actual dispatch record

return.timestamp: actual return timestamp at or after review timestamp
return.record_digest: SHA256 of retained actual return record, distinct from dispatch

attestation: exact review object plus execution_evidence_digest = SHA256(canonical execution envelope)
limitations: Validator checks bindings, not semantic independence; coordinator retains original dispatch and return records privately.
